subtasks: Observe the object placement order and remember it. Keep both of your arms at their starting poses until the demonstrating arm has fully returned to its starting pose; placing the last object does not mean the demonstration is finished. Only then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order. Finally, return both of your arms to their starting poses.
Place the near purple keypad phone in the left basket.
Place the brown plush rabbit from the middle of the table into the near-left basket.
Place the green wristwatch from the right side of the table into the near-left basket.
Place the light blue toy car from the near right side of the table into the near-left basket.
Place the last black rectangular device from the table into the near-left basket.
Return both arms to their initial starting poses with both grippers fully open. Leave all objects in their baskets.
